articles.title: LPL Financial Welcomes Cebert Wealth Advisors
articles.description: SAN DIEGO, May 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LPL Financial LLC announced today that the financial advisors of Cebert Wealth Advisors have joined LPL Financial’s broker-dealer and Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) platform. The team reported serving approximately $1 billion in advisory, brokerage and retirement plan assets* and joins LPL from Ameriprise.
